descricao_original: This higher magnification image shows a region of fibrocartilage adjacent to bone. Numerous chondrocytes are visible surrounded by pale-staining matrix and horizontally-oriented collagen fibers. The anatomical basis is for the basophilic staining in the center of the image is unclear. 1000x

marcadores.explicacao_original: In the dense regular connective tissue composing the tendon, fibroblasts are inactive with flattened, heterochromatic nuclei (black arrows). The extracellular matrix consists almost exclusively of regularly arranged collagen bundles with little ground substance.
marcadores.legenda_ia: Camada transparente de anotacao da pagina 'Fibrocartilage'. Deve ser sobreposta, sem redimensionamento independente, a 'T.C.C.F.07A.jpg'. Destaca a estrutura ou conceito 'Tendon' por setas, contornos ou marcadores coloridos (incluindo vermelho quando presente).
